title: Work of the Holy Spirit
definition: The work of the Holy Spirit includes convicting the world, regenerating sinners, uniting believers to Christ, sanctifying them, giving gifts, producing fruit, and empowering witness.
summary: The Spirit brings the saving work of Christ into the life of the believer. He opens blind eyes, creates faith, bears witness that we are God’s children, and enables obedience.
christFocus: The believer walks in victory not by self-effort but by faith in Christ and dependence on the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The Spirit sanctifies and empowers believers for obedience and mission.
